However, given the taxonomy 'Technology & AI' and the subject of ADAS/AV, this is a strong link. 2023 D002 mentions autonomous driving; 2024 D069 details Mobileye's role in it.

comparisons.peer_summary: Automotive revenue for fiscal year 2024 increased 21%, primarily reflecting growth in self-driving platforms.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA disclose business activities related to self-driving technologies and autonomous vehicle platforms in their 2024 Item 7 filings. Intel describes Mobileye as a leader in self-driving solutions providing the full stack for autonomous driving. NVIDIA reports specific revenue growth from its automotive segment, driven by self-driving platforms. While Intel focuses on the technological breadth and platform composition of its subsidiary (Mobileye), NVIDIA focuses on the financial performance and growth rate of its automotive revenue segment.

sentences.text: Mobileye is a global leader in driving assistance and self-driving solutions, with a product portfolio designed to encompass the entire stack required for assisted and autonomous driving, including compute platforms, computer vision, and machine learning-based perception, mapping and localization, driving policy, and active sensors in development.
Automotive revenue for the fiscal year 2024 was up 21%.
The increase primarily reflected growth in self-driving platforms.
